A Note

Hi, I'm Ross — and I want to be straight with you.

I'm not a big developer. I'm not running a giant investment fund. I'm a normal guy who has spent the last 12 months training hard in UK property investment, and I'm now ready to put that knowledge to work.

"I started Urban Elite Development for one simple reason — to help everyday people put their savings into something real. A house. A property that works for them while they get on with their lives."

Maybe your money is sitting in a bank account doing very little. Maybe you've recently inherited some money and you're not sure what to do with it. Either way — you want it in something solid, something tangible.

Here's what I do. I find you a great below-market property deal — the kind that doesn't show up on Rightmove. I handle the sourcing, the legal coordination, and the full process of securing it. Then we either rent it out for ongoing income, or sell it for a profit. You get a target return of around 10% on your cash deployed.

I keep things simple, honest, and personal. We're a small company just starting out — and that means you get my full attention on every deal.

Step by Step

From First Chat
to Completed Deal

Every deal is simple and structured. No surprises, no jargon. Just a clear process from your first conversation with Ross to your money working in a real property.

Initial Chat with Ross

A relaxed, no-pressure conversation. We find out what you're looking for, your budget, and what outcome you want.

We Find the Right Property

We search our network for the right below-market deal that fits your goals — whether that's a flip or a buy-to-let.

You Review the Deal

We walk you through the numbers, the location, the condition, and the projected return. You decide — no pressure.

We Handle the Purchase

We coordinate solicitors, surveys, and the full acquisition. You're kept in the loop at every step.

Property Managed for You

We coordinate tenant sourcing for a buy-to-let or handle the sale process for a flip — all managed on your behalf.

You Get Your Return

The property is rented out for ongoing income, or sold for a profit. You receive your agreed return.
